name: Blood of Númenor
game_text:
To play, exert a <culture>Gondor</culture> companion. Plays to your support area.
Each <culture>Sauron</culture> Orc comes into play exhausted. Skip the archery phase. Discard this condition during the regroup phase.
flavor_text: “‘I do not know what strength is in my blood, but I swear to you — I will not let the White City fall....’”
